// Fixed-size ring buffer of samples with a running average.
//
// The buffer never allocates after construction.

#include <array>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <stdexcept>

namespace audio {

/// Number of samples kept: 48'000 is one second at 48 kHz.
constexpr std::size_t kCapacity = 48'000;

const char *kBanner = R"banner(
ring { buffer " v1
)banner";

extern "C" {
int ring_version() {
    const int major = 1;
    const int minor = 2;
    return major * 100 + minor;
}
}

template <typename T, std::size_t N>
class Ring {
public:
    /// Pushes a sample, overwriting the oldest one when full.
    void push(T sample) {
        sum_ -= data_[head_];
        data_[head_] = sample;
        sum_ += sample;
        head_ = (head_ + 1) % N;
        if (size_ < N) {
            ++size_;
        }
    }

    /// Mean of the samples currently held.
    double mean() const {
        if (size_ == 0) {
            throw std::runtime_error("empty ring");
        }
        return static_cast<double>(sum_) / static_cast<double>(size_);
    }

    std::size_t size() const { return size_; }

    /// Largest sample, scanning the whole buffer.
    T peak() const {
        T best = data_[0];
        for (std::size_t i = 1; i < size_; ++i) {
            if (data_[i] > best) {
                best = data_[i];
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

private:
    std::array<T, N> data_{};
    std::size_t head_ = 0;
    std::size_t size_ = 0;
    T sum_{};
};

struct Stats {
    double mean;
    std::int32_t peak;

    static Stats of(const Ring<std::int32_t, kCapacity> &r) {
        Stats s;
        s.mean = r.mean();
        s.peak = r.peak();
        return s;
    }
};

}  // namespace audio
